heading.title: Of the Duties of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Executor or administrator not bound to pay legacies without indemnity.
article.content: If the estate of the deceased is subject to any contingent liabilities, an executor or administrator is not bound to pay any legacy without a sufficient indemnity to meet the liabilities whenever they may become due.
article.html:
326Executor or administrator not bound to pay legacies without indemnity.

Section 326 · Part IX · Chapter VII · page 85 of the Act

If the estate of the deceased is subject to any contingent liabilities, an executor or administrator is not bound to pay any legacy without a sufficient indemnity to meet the liabilities whenever they may become due.
article.inner_html:
326Executor or administrator not bound to pay legacies without indemnity.

Section 326 · Part IX · Chapter VII · page 85 of the Act

If the estate of the deceased is subject to any contingent liabilities, an executor or administrator is not bound to pay any legacy without a sufficient indemnity to meet the liabilities whenever they may become due.
